rules: get_metadata elides children of large frames and shows them as empty leaves. NEVER declare a node empty on get_metadata alone — confirm with get_figma_data or get_screenshot.
get_variable_defs is NODE-SCOPED. One call is never the full variable set. Union across canonical frames.
theme() does NOT work inside a style="" attribute — Tailwind never processes it. The gradient silently breaks.
Stack is Laravel 12, token file is tailwind.config.js (NOT .ts).
Fonts are Peyda (FA body) / Maneli (display accents) / Poppins (EN-Desktop styles). NOT Vazirmatn — that is only a fallback.
Asset path convention is resources/images/sizdah/** via the ~img alias. Do NOT create resources/js/icons/.
Figma export URLs expire (~7 days) AND can return 0 bytes silently. stat -c%s every downloaded file.
